identificationModule.briefTitle: Second-line Treatment of Metastatic Colorectal Cancer
identificationModule.officialTitle: Irinotecan in Combination With Trifluridine-tipiracil and Bevacizumab in Pre-treated Metastatic Colorectal Cancer

collaborators.name: The Affiliated Hospital of Qingdao University

descriptionModule.briefSummary: The goal of this multicenter, single-arm, observational cohort study is to investigate the efficacy and safety of irinotecan in combination with trifluridine-tipiracil and bevacizumab in colorectal cancer with prior oxaliplatin and fluoropyrimidine-based chemotherapy (including 5-FU/capecitabine/S-1) exposure in the metastatic setting or within 12 months of recurrence.

interventions.name: Trifluridine/tipiracil
interventions.description: patients received biweekly Trifluridine/tipiracil (30 mg/m2 twice daily; days 1-5), irinotecan (150 mg/m2; day 1) and bevacizumab (5 mg/kg; day 1).

primaryOutcomes.description: From date of randomization until the date of first documented progression or date of death from any cause, whichever came first,
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: from the date of randomization up to 36 months

secondaryOutcomes.description: ORR was defined as the percentage of participants who had shown complete response (CR) or partial response (PR) as the best overall response in accordance with the RECIST 1.1 criteria after randomization.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: from the date of randomization up to 36 months

secondaryOutcomes.description: Defined as the percentage of patients who have achieved complete response (CR), partial response (PR) and stable disease (SD).
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: from the date of randomization up to 36 months

secondaryOutcomes.description: OS was defined as the time from the day of randomization (Day 0) until death by all causes.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: from the date of randomization up to 36 months

secondaryOutcomes.description: Adverse events were recorded according to Common Terminology Criteria for Adverse Events (version 5.0) of the National Cancer Institute that participants received at least one dose of protocol treatment after randomization.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Up to 28 days after discontinuation of study drug or start of subsequent therapy.

secondaryOutcomes.description: From the date of response until the date of first documented disease progression or death.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: from the date of randomization up to 36 months
